text: 国际货币基金组织(IMF)总裁格奥尔基耶娃：各国央行应高度关注物价稳定。 大多数高负债国家要维持稳定，都需要进行财政整顿。 鉴于人工智能变革的速度，各国必须采取措施准备好迎接人工智能时代。
text_en: IMF Managing Director Georgieva: Central banks in all countries should pay close attention to price stability. Most highly indebted countries need fiscal consolidation to maintain stability. Given the pace of AI transformation, countries must take measures to prepare for the AI era.
